paragraphs: Players Health sells insurance together with the staff and software a sports program needs to keep participants protected. The company dates the work to 2016 and has widened the roster since then to insurance, athlete safety, and employee benefits products and services. On the insurance side it describes athlete-first protection sold to youth sports nationwide.

Policies cover a league or program against unexpected accidents, injuries, or property damage. A separate directors and officers line is offered as legal protection for a board. Alongside the policies sits a suite of athlete safety products meant to protect youth and amateur athletes, fitness club members, and student athletes. Programs that do not know where to begin can ask for a Players Health Safety Score to work out what steps they need. Training is pitched at coaches and organizations building team cultures and keeping their programs positive and safe. A reporting platform carries incidents from the first report through to resolution.

The founder, Tyrre, started the company after a playing career at Winona State and in the Canadian Football League was plagued with injuries. By its own account the company now supports over 40,000 sports organizations, impacting more than 5 million athletes. It states its mission as creating the safest and most accessible environments for athletes to play the sports they love.
